title: Excalibur | Sweety's Archaeology Support
description: A non official compatibility pack between Excalibur and Sweety's Archaeology mod.
body:
This Texture pack Re-textures all the Blocks, Mobs and Gui's from the Sweety's Archaeology
mod to better fit Excalibur.

See Gallery for the the textures.


Best Used with Excalibur

And Requires Sweety's Archaeology

I also recommend using Excalibur | Create Support
By BoFill_Pablito As he made the watch texture and gave me premission to use his create seat textures for the tuff podiums.


Enjoy.
